metadata.name: maira_phrase_candidates
metadata.description: High-confidence phrasing candidates for MAIRA/MAIRA-2 based on publicly available MAIRA-2 and PadChest-GR materials, grouped by confidence level.
notes: This is not an official label taxonomy from MAIRA/MAIRA-2.
Tier 1 focuses on the very stable MIMIC/MS-CXR findings and support-device phrases explicitly evidenced in public MAIRA-2 or MS-CXR materials.
Tier 2 contains phrases explicitly appearing in MAIRA-2 examples or PadChest-GR public examples.
Tier 3 contains conservative recommended phrases aligned with chest X-ray radiology wording and the grounded-report / phrase-grounding setup.

tier_1_most_stable.description: Very stable phrases: the 8 MS-CXR/MIMIC finding categories plus support-device phrases directly evidenced in MAIRA-2 public examples.

tier_2_explicit_examples.description: Phrases explicitly appearing in public MAIRA-2 examples or PadChest-GR public examples.

tier_3_conservative_recommendations.description: Conservative recommended phrasing candidates that are not framed as official labels, but are likely to align better with chest X-ray report wording than generic anatomy nouns.
